def: Software that uses natural language processing to understand spoken commands and assist with hands free requests.
Amazon Alexa, Apple Siri, and Google Assistant.
Algorithms that analyze past user behavior and preferences to suggest relevant content or products.
Netflix suggesting movies or Spotify curating music playlists.
Machines or vehicles that interpret their surroundings and react to them in real time without continuous human steering.
Self driving cars (like those from Tesla) navigating traffic.
AI driven interfaces designed to converse with users, resolve support issues, and answer routine questions 24/7.
Website customer service bots and text based platforms like ChatGPT.Smart Home AutomationDefinition Devices that adjust settings automatically by learning from daily household behaviors.
Machine learning models that automatically organize inboxes, detect spam, and suggest replies.
